title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-14
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with buzzing mix issues on the electric set, but a superb acoustic half featuring How Long Blues and a rare David Crosby jam.
ai_review.review: The acoustic portion of this show shines – banter, a rare "How Long Blues" performance and an unexpected guest spot by David Crosby make it a keep‑list favorite. The electric side suffers from mix problems and buzzing, with missing "Frozen Logger" and a cut in "Easy Wind," though moments like the "China > Rider" transition and thick 1970‑style drums on "The Other One" still stand out.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings, praising the acoustic set while noting significant flaws in the electric mix; weighted toward show quality (70%) yields a solid but not outstanding score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Electric set plagued by buzzing and mix problems; acoustic set sounds clear with good banter. No major drop‑outs reported, but overall balance is uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic half is tight and engaging, while the electric half feels uneven – solid highlights are offset by missing pieces and mix issues.

band_member_comments.Bob: Takes his time with lyrics on "El Paso," giving a unique vocal delivery.
band_member_comments.Drums: "The Other One" features thick‑nice 1970 style drumming.
